cells.gaps: No act or body is named for the approval (SLE-002 says 'approved' in 2021; the policy text itself, SLE-011, only recommends approval). Governance facts for the policy (SLE-014 body:none, SLE-015 finance:not-stated) are dated 2021, outside the 36 months, so governance is empty; nothing dated in the last twelve months. Other national instruments held: National Innovation and Digital Strategy 2019-2029 (public text, standing only launched; also stage 3, older), National Digital Development Strategy 2022 (validated/drafting, no adoption or public-text row) and a draft National Digital Transformation Roadmap. Stage 4 needs a delivery plan and published results; the policy has neither.
cells.note: Instrument: National Digital Development Policy 2021, the newest adopted instrument. Adopted, public text and an open period make stage 3; no plan and no reporting rule out stage 4.
